name: OpenField judge preview
readme: OpenField (open-source, local-first creative suite on ComfyUI and the Comfy SDK) as a password-gated judge preview. Attach a network volume of 150 GB or more at /workspace; the first boot downloads about 92 GB of models there. Open port 3161 through the HTTP proxy and sign in with the judge password. See docs/RUNPOD.md in the repository.
